component.name: Lemonade
component.summary: Local LLM Server and Desktop Application

description.p: Lemonade is a lightweight, high-performance local LLM server supporting multiple backends including llama.cpp, FastFlowLM, and RyzenAI.

ul.li: Network (--share=network): download backends and models; serve the bundled lemond HTTP API.
GPU (--device=dri): Tauri/WebKitGTK rendering and GPU inference backends.

Tray (--talk-name=org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher): system-tray indicator to manage the server. The StatusNotifierItem and single-instance/deep-link bus names are app-ID sub-names owned under the default dbus-proxy policy, so no --own-name is requested.
Model cache (--filesystem=xdg-cache/huggingface:rw): reuse ~/.cache/huggingface so models from other AI tools aren't re-downloaded.
Runtime dir (--filesystem=xdg-run/lemonade:rw): transient logs under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/lemonade/, cleared on logout.

description.p: Update to lemonade v10.5.1: built-in MTP support, vision model labels, and updated llama.cpp/ROCm backends. Removes the deprecated lemonade-server CLI shim.
Update to lemonade v10.4.0 with vLLM backend support and model manager improvements.
